name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: CVE-2026-18577 — N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.dek: N-able N-central. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 6 August.

items.title: Inverting the Hidden: Unveiling Multimodal Privacy Leakage in Collaborative LVLM Inference
items.dek: RASR attack recovers visual content from intermediate hidden states in collaborative LVLM inference by 50% better than prior methods, demonstrating privacy leak in edge-cloud deployments.
items.unproven: tested on two LVLM families; whether attack scales to production-grade defenses or white-box detection mechanisms

items.title: Registry Descriptions Go Stale Unevenly: An 89-Day Measurement of Model Context Protocol Drift, and Why Drift-Ranked Re-Auditing Under-Covers It
items.dek: MCP registry descriptions decay unevenly over 89 days; re-auditing high-drift servers catches only 20% of description changes versus 27% for random re-auditing.
items.unproven: limited to single registry; whether findings apply to other package ecosystems with different churn rates or governance models

items.title: A False Average: Chain-of-Thought Monitors Collapse Where They Are the Only Defense
items.dek: Rewriting chain-of-thought reasoning while preserving actions drops monitor catch rate from 95% to 11% on hacks where reasoning is the only defense signal.
items.unproven: attack is demonstrated on fixed Gemini proposals and lab agents; does not establish whether production monitors with external trace signals or live human oversight recover the defense substantially

items.title: Safety Invariants for Agents Orchestrating Irreversible State Transitions: A Four-Dimensional Formalism Evaluated on Public Ledgers
items.dek: Four-dimensional formalism with seven safety invariants guarantees irreversible ledger transitions execute exactly once, even under retry and delegation faults.
items.unproven: Whether execution-fidelity theorem holds when user-intent preview itself contains ambiguity; applicability to non-ledger irreversible state changes.

items.title: When Prompts Control Robots: Prompt Injection Attacks in Multi-Agent Robotic Systems
items.dek: Prompt injection in multi-agent robotic systems propagates across agents via shared prompts; first systematic study of cross-agent contamination.
items.unproven: Whether defenses tested on lab robotic rigs generalize to production hardware; long-horizon attack composition beyond single injection.

items.title: Adversarial Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines: Unveiling Structural Vulnerabilities in Agentic AI Architectures
items.dek: Multi-agent LLM pipelines lack inter-agent boundary verification, enabling content injection, impersonation, plan deviation, and memory poisoning from benign deployments.
items.unproven: Whether proposed boundary verification primitives can be retrofitted to existing production pipelines without latency penalty; defense effectiveness against composite attacks.

items.title: Domain Decoupling Attack: Exploiting the Validation Gap Between Protective DNS and Shared Edge Routing
items.dek: DNS-based validation gap allows reuse of shared IP authorization to reach co-tenant domains; 95.8% exposure rate across measured domains.
items.unproven: measurement scope is passive DNS and routing enumeration; does not demonstrate active exploitation or quantify real-world attack surface for any specific infrastructure operator

items.title: NoisePQC++: A Unified NIST-Compliant PQC and Hybrid-PQC Implementation of the Noise Protocol
items.dek: CryptoProver verifies curve25519-dalek and ChaCha20 implementations using LLM-synthesized proofs in Verus, covering 57 classical and 13 post-quantum Noise handshake patterns.
items.unproven: proofs synthesized with fixed library of axioms trusted without independent audit; whether approach scales to cryptographic libraries without available specifications

items.title: Hardware-rooted attestation for AI-agent evidence: composing IETF RATS with action evidence packages
items.dek: Composite attestation binds hardware RATS appraisal to software action evidence packages to verify deployed model version produced agent output.
items.unproven: Practical deployment model when agent output timing does not align with measured-boot attestation cycles; whether Veraison performance scales to multi-agent scenarios.

items.title: Robust Watermarks Meet Backdoored Models: Evading Diffusion Semantic Watermarks via Stealthy Backdoor
items.dek: Backdoored VAE encoder evades three state-of-the-art semantic watermarks on diffusion models with 94.6% success while preserving detection on benign images.
items.unproven: attack requires control of model training; does not demonstrate feasibility against watermarks applied post-deployment or integrated into inference pipelines outside the evaluated architectures

items.title: MAPLE-Guard: Memory-Aware Link Enforcement Against Memory-Link Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
items.dek: MAPLE-Guard places gates at memory write, retrieval, promotion, and cross-agent reuse in multi-agent systems to intercept memory-poisoning attacks.
items.unproven: evaluation scope and threat model are not fully specified in the abstract; does not establish performance overhead, false-positive rates in benign workflows, or compatibility with production memory systems

items.title: Decoy Images Amplify Caption-Mediated Defenses Against Encoded Jailbreaks
items.dek: Decoy images reduce encoded jailbreak success by up to 73 percentage points on vision-language models by triggering image-branch defenses.
items.unproven: mechanism confirmed only through indirect evidence in black-box setting; whether effect transfers to production deployments with different moderation pipelines

items.title: CallScreenBench: Benchmarking On-Device Models as Phone Secretaries
items.dek: Benchmark for on-device phone-secretary models shows quality scales with capability but triage performance measurement is an artifact of degenerate agent baselines.
items.unproven: results limited to six models at 0.6–4B parameters; whether findings generalize to larger quantized models or different task domains

items.title: Complete Existence Classification of Seven-Partite Absolutely Maximally Entangled States
items.dek: Mathematical proof establishes absolutely maximally entangled states exist for seven qudits when local dimension is at least 3.

items.title: From AI Technical Debt to Agentic Technical Debt: A Systematic Mapping of Root Causes and Manifestations in Agentic AI Systems
items.dek: Framework maps traditional AI technical debt to agentic systems, identifying memory inconsistency and emergent failures as new debt categories in autonomous multi-agent settings.
items.unproven: taxonomy without empirical validation on deployed agent systems; no measurement of debt manifestation frequency or impact severity

items.title: RFC 10015: Deprecating Obsolete Key Exchange Methods in TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2
items.dek: RFC 10015 proposes deprecating obsolete key exchange methods in TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2.
items.unproven: does not establish timeline for enforcement or impact on legacy systems the reader must support

items.title: Explainable Hybrid Feature Selection for Intrusion Detection in Internet of Medical Things Environments
items.dek: Feature selection via correlation and SHAP reduces IoMT IDS input from 40 to 5 features with minimal accuracy loss.
items.unproven: Generalization beyond CIC-IoMT 2024 and CIC-IDS 2017; whether selected features remain stable across device heterogeneity in production.

items.title: Supporting Cybersecurity Risk Management for Medical Devices via the SECUMAN Ontology and Shapes
items.dek: SECUMAN OWL ontology and SHACL shapes formalize cybersecurity risk documentation for medical devices, aligned with VDE Spec 90025.
items.unproven: Adoption and interoperability with existing clinical engineering workflows; whether formal validation catches real compliance gaps in production filings.

items.title: Improving the Security of Containerized Workloads using Transparency and Traceability Services
items.dek: Proof-of-concept container image verification architecture using transparency logs and policy-as-code to enforce supply-chain integrity at admission time.
items.unproven: demonstration is limited to GitHub Actions and GitLab Runners; does not establish scalability, operational overhead, or adoption friction in production pipelines across heterogeneous environments

items.title: Smaller, faster, safer: running Kimi and GLM at scale
items.dek: Cloudflare deployment patterns for inference models; operational vocabulary for running large language models at scale.
items.unproven: limited to Cloudflare's infrastructure and chosen models; generalizability to other deployment contexts unclear

items.title: Critical CVE issued for hallucinated SQLite vulnerability
items.dek: CVE vulnerability analysis of SQLite hallucination illustrates supply-chain risk communication patterns.
items.unproven: link text only; actual vulnerability details and exploitation scope not accessible in submission

items.title: Harvesting SSH Credentials: Insights from My Honeypot Network
items.dek: Honeypot data characterizes SSH credential theft patterns; no novel attack method.
items.unproven: generalization beyond the operator's network and threat model

items.title: A Decade of Healthcare Cyber Threats: Empirical Analysis, Evidence-Based Prioritisation, and AI Threat Model
items.dek: Analysis of 1,214 healthcare threat records from 2017–2024 shows defense evasion persistent at 15–20% while persistence and initial access declined to zero.
items.unproven: limited to documented threats in MITRE ATT&CK, CISA, and NIST sources; dark-market and unattributed attacks absent; whether decline reflects detection gaps or true attacker shift

items.title: Multi-LLM Consensus Framework for Evaluating Banking-Sector NIDS Dataset Coverage of MITRE ATT&CK Techniques
items.dek: Multi-LLM consensus maps MITRE ATT&CK techniques to banking NIDS datasets; finds 68 techniques in standard benchmarks.
items.unproven: Whether sector-specific dataset coverage correlates with operational detection rate in live financial networks; single benchmark evaluated.

noise.title: Devtools must be open source
noise.dek: Opinion piece arguing for open-source development tools; no evidence or novel argument.

noise.title: Utah produced more power from solar than any other source in May, a new first
noise.dek: Utah energy generation milestone; entirely outside application security and SDLC scope.

noise.title: Californians' data deletion requests, DROP, become enforceable Aug. 1
